scope: Income questions over the clean money view (txn.income_minor), traced by reading worker/src/lib/clean-money.js, worker/src/lib/ledger-analysis.js and worker/src/lib/money-query-quality.js at base.

schema.defaults: Unless a case overrides: tenant 'primary'; every account owned, basis_state confirmed, entity 'business' (kind business) except entity 'household' where stated; feed_mode live; one current fin_account_coverage row per account: coverage_status complete, basis_state confirmed, covered_from 2026-01-01, covered_to 2026-10-31, basis_note NULL; every row posted (pending 0), basis_state confirmed, provenance feed, currency USD, payee NULL, category NULL.
schema.expected: Bookkeeper answer: figure, figure_minor, rows counted, not_counted (row + why), confidence word.
schema.confidence_rule: High = no uncertain income dollars (every counted or excluded inflow has income words, processor identity, interest/proceeds code, owner-confirmed category, account-kind rule or proved/resolved endpoint), coverage complete, nothing pending/unreadable/duplicated/outside dates. Medium = uncertain dollars (counted or left out) at most 50% of the headline, or a pending/duplicate/coverage note. Low = uncertain dollars over 50% of the headline (including a $0 headline with uncertain items), or unreadable rows.
schema.code: Base behaviour: figure_minor = SUM(txn.income_minor) for the period/side (+ guide net-sales adjustment for C19-C21), counted rows, moneyQueryQuality display, verdicts, deciding rule.
